cohort: The study included 1,318,604 WIC-eligible women of reproductive age, whose deliveries were paid with Medicaid, and who gave birth to a singleton, live birth at a hospital in the United States in 2023.
finding: Prenatal WIC participation was associated with a small reduction in the risk of low gestational weight gain z-score and slow gestational weight gain rate among WIC-eligible United States women.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from birth records in 2023, observing maternal prepregnancy weight, weight at delivery, and WIC participation during pregnancy.
